scope: Shared mobile-web/PWA and TAKY execution-growth gaps discovered from current repository inspection plus external engineering ecosystem comparison.

state_semantics.OPEN: Material gap remains to be implemented or validated.
state_semantics.PARTIAL: Some supporting implementation exists but exit conditions are not met.
state_semantics.VALIDATED: Exit conditions are met for the declared scope.
state_semantics.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a newer gap/pattern with lineage.

items.title: Atomic safe-point PWA update lifecycle
evidence: TAKY shared CAP-PWA-UPDATE-001 reference implementation is active.
Ready/Hide/Snap shared PWA update consumers are CI/runtime verified.
Device/installed-PWA verification remains open, so VALIDATED is not claimed.
items.improvement_direction: Unify DETECT -> DOWNLOAD -> WAITING -> SAFE_POINT -> ACTIVATE -> VERSION_HANDSHAKE -> RESTORE behavior across the app family.
exit_conditions: No service-worker activation can invalidate an active learning session.
Waiting update is explicit and traceable.
Old/new app shell asset mixing is regression-tested.
Representative installed-PWA update flow is runtime/device verified.
items.owner_destination: Learning App Family + each project runtime

items.title: App/SW/schema version tuple and compatibility check
evidence: TAKY shared CAP-RELEASE-COMPAT-001 reference implementation is active.
Ready/Hide/Snap consume the shared release contract with CI/runtime evidence.
Device/release-wide schema migration and rollback proof remains outside the current shared validation scope.
items.improvement_direction: Create one machine-readable release tuple containing app_version, sw_version, data_schema_version and contract_version; verify compatibility at boot/update.
exit_conditions: One authoritative release tuple is consumed by app and service worker.
Build/CI fails on incompatible or drifting version identifiers.
Migration/rollback behavior is defined for schema changes.
items.owner_destination: Learning App Family release contract + project build/runtime

items.title: Version-aware local-first reconciliation
evidence: Ready-Set already has IndexedDB snapshots, outbox, retries, idempotency and a conflict store.
Current conflict resolution is whole-payload KEEP_LOCAL or ACCEPT_REMOTE without explicit base/local/remote version semantics.
items.improvement_direction: Add entity/base/local/remote versions and classify mergeable, authority-owned and semantic conflicts before synchronization is expanded.
exit_conditions: Concurrent edits cannot silently overwrite newer accepted state.
Conflict classification and deterministic resolution rules exist.
Retry remains idempotent across reconnect/reload.
Representative concurrent/offline replay passes.
items.owner_destination: SHARED_TECHNICAL_CAPABILITY queue/sync mechanisms + Ready/Learning-owned conflict semantics

items.title: Separate current state synchronization from event/history identity
evidence: TAKY CAP-EVENT-ENVELOPE-001 provides immutable event identity separate from payload digest.
Ready/Hide/Snap event-envelope consumers are migrated with regression evidence.
Domain-owned long-term history semantics and full replay behavior remain project/domain responsibilities.
items.improvement_direction: Use explicit immutable event_id for history/events and separate state snapshot/version identity for synchronization.
exit_conditions: Repeated identical user events remain distinguishable when history requires it.
Snapshot deduplication does not erase material event history.
Event replay is idempotent.
items.owner_destination: SHARED_TECHNICAL_CAPABILITY event-envelope mechanism + owning Learning OS/project history semantics

items.title: Cross-app registry and contract handshake
evidence: Ready-Set runtime currently contains hard-coded hosted origins for specialist apps and passes session identifiers through URL/runtime bridges.
items.improvement_direction: Introduce a family app registry with app_id, origin, contract_version, minimum_compatible_version, capabilities and return protocol; reject incompatible handoffs before navigation.
exit_conditions: No project requires hard-coded opaque production origin in business logic.
Cross-app contract incompatibility is detected before handoff.
Return/result deduplication is version-aware.
Local/preview/production environments can map origins without changing domain logic.
items.owner_destination: Learning App Family shared runtime contract

items.title: External side-effect budget and evidence yield
evidence: TAKY generic pre-action enforcement now blocks duplicate external calls without new evidence.
External call budget, frozen-candidate-before-deploy and lower-cost-local-validation gates exist in ENFORCEMENT/taky_gate.py.
Cross-run historical evidence-yield accounting remains open.
items.improvement_direction: Track external preview/build/deploy/API/agent actions as side effects with purpose, evidence expected, actual evidence and retry reason.
exit_conditions: Repeated external call without new evidence is blocked or explicitly justified.
Frozen-candidate deploy path is distinguishable from implementation/test work.
External-call history can explain why each costly action occurred.

items.title: Outcome and learning feedback metrics
evidence: Current TAKY is strong in rule/validation evidence but has less explicit measurement of whether new rules and patterns reduce rework, regressions or user-debugging burden.

TAKY draft-only ENFORCEMENT/growth_outcome_observation.py plus 10 synthetic replay cases: explicit before/after evidence, material source changes and missing real-outcome scope are deterministically differentiated. Does not perform monitoring or confer owner/approval/release authority.

2026-09-28 first owner evidence snapshot records source-scoped CI before/after for Hide, bounded Ready CI-versus-device gap, and ARCHI GROW unobserved Work artifact. Replayed in existing TAKY CI. These are historical scoped observations, not live watches or app-level runtime consumers.

Recovered AG-014 original YKH 38p, existing V02 source+QA board and V5 two-page preview: previous handoff-only 'not observed' inference corrected. Preview existence is observed, while actual Work result/architect acceptance and concrete V02 QA carry-forward remain OPEN. 5 owner observations in HISTORY/2026-09-28_GROWTH_OUTCOME_OWNER_OBSERVATION.json.

AG-014 source-role correction: separate six-page Hannam REV01 design-study report reflects user-specified latest 1F +88.65 / 2F +92.15 and road average +82.88, while earlier Work section/FACT_LOCK still depicts +88.00 / +91.80; original DWG acquired but semantic entity parsing not proven. V5 comparison board does not supersede V02 QA or canonical Work geometry. Owner ARCHIGROW_APPLICATION AG-014 review/result cell updated without status promotion.
items.improvement_direction: Record fit-for-purpose before/change/after evidence for recurring failure, recovery, rework, external calls and implementation completion. Connect intended result to before/after evidence, owner-declared material-change triggers, the next relevant review and actual outcome; report the evidence-level gap instead of calling fixture/CI activity real-world improvement.
exit_conditions: Material adopted growth changes have at least one relevant outcome signal where measurable.
Rules that add cost without demonstrated value can be adjusted or retired.
CURRENT_BEST updates cite outcome/regression evidence.

Representative owning project feeds a genuinely observed outcome and a materially changed source/action through this read-only path, and proves its own follow-up reduced a relevant failure/rework or improved the user result.

A CI-only or reference-only outcome cannot satisfy a separately required device, live-provider or operational evidence scope, and no observation alone promotes CURRENT_BEST or reopens CLOSED without new evidence.
A project-owned, source-locked actual work or learning outcome must be measured before any USER_OUTCOME_VERIFIED claim; a real CI observation alone does not satisfy this.

implementation_candidate.role: Deterministically classify owner-submitted observation evidence; no new AI, watch service, workflow scheduler or global semantic authority.
implementation_candidate.reference_origin: User-supplied eight-frame social carousel about a '24-hour trader'; method analogy only, NOT proof of the pictured author's system, trading outcome, safety or TAKY runtime.

downstream_owner_routes.candidate: Changed public-data or design-condition evidence -> inspect only affected alternatives; architecture rules/decisions remain project owned.
New validated learning outcome -> re-evaluate pedagogical intent in Core, while Planner alone places dates.
Order/address/shipping exception and correction outcome -> reassess only affected order; Parent retains confirmation.
Material source revision, repeated defect, or post-change outcome delta -> owner-scoped follow-up using actual evidence, no auto re-open of CLOSED.

items.title: GitHub ecosystem pattern intelligence as repeatable research input
evidence: Current Deep Analysis already calls for relevant case research and principle extraction.
GitHub repo, issues, discussions, PR/release/community evidence is not yet represented as a persistent growth backlog/learning loop.
items.improvement_direction: Use TKY-GROWTH-001 to turn high-signal repository/community research into pattern records, localized candidates, experiments and CURRENT_BEST/FRONTIER updates.
exit_conditions: Deep-search results preserve inspected cases and concrete local gaps.
Material adopted findings have owner/destination and validation evidence.
Research does not collapse into generic policy accumulation.
